definitions.gloss: to line up; to form a line; to stand in a row
definitions.explanation: To arrange oneself or others in an orderly line or formation. Commonly used in schools, military, and organized events.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一列|いちれつ}→一列：11228_ichiretsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{整列|せいれつ}する。
examples.english: To line up in a single row.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{校庭|こうてい}→校庭：04147_koutei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{整列|せいれつ}した。
examples.english: The students lined up in the schoolyard.

examples.japanese: ⟦{背|せ}→背：02907_se⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{整列|せいれつ}して⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please line up in order of height.

notes:
A ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧-verb from ⟦{整列|せいれつ}→整列：15265_seiretsu⟧, a compound of {整|せい} (arrange) and ⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧ (row, line). Implies forming an orderly, organized line, not just casually standing together. Very common in school settings where students regularly line up for assemblies and roll call.

TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive — the people themselves line up. Can also be used transitively in computing contexts (to sort/align data).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{一列|いちれつ}→一列：11228_ichiretsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{整列|せいれつ}する — to line up in a single row
- ⟦{背|せ}→背：02907_se⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{整列|せいれつ}する — to line up by height
- ⟦{整列|せいれつ}→整列：15265_seiretsu⟧！ — Line up! (command)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧ — to line up, to stand in line (more casual, general)
- ⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ — to form a line
- ⟦{行列|ぎょうれつ}→行列：09699_gyouretsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to queue up (for a shop, event, etc.)
